{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "own": "<id from her_items or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description", ""her_items" — her own items; an item of the description that is one of them gets its id in "own""]}, "description": "Linen dress Amora from vilni.store, loose relaxed fit, knee-length, #b86c4f (terracotta), linen.
Flat leather sandals with a low block heel, open toe, #deb295, soft nappa leather.
Gold tone minimal link bracelet and matching small hoop earrings in polished brass.
This outfit honors her specific wish for a walk featuring the terracotta linen dress Amora, keeping the look effortless and natural for autumn daylight. The loose cut of the linen fabric ensures comfort while moving, complemented by neutral tones that ground the warm hue without competing with it. Accessories are kept subtle to let the texture of the dress remain the focal point of this everyday ensemble.", "her_items": [{"id": "її-с1", "name": "лляною сукнею Амора з vilni.store, крамниця називає її теракотовою"}]}
